texts: On day 258 of Year 1, a crowd of nightmoths gathered at the Harbor Row.
Three sky-cats descended from the cliff-spires.
The three sky-cats hunted the nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row.
The nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row shrank.
Coraline Ash counted twenty-four nightmoths at the lantern of the Harbor Station before the hunt.
Coraline Ash counted nine nightmoths at the lantern of the Harbor Station after the hunt.
Coraline Ash wrote notes about the hunt.

q1_issues.issue: In "The nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row shrank" the PP sits inside the subject NP and so states where the crowd is, but the parse emits an event Location on the shrinking instead of an entity-attached position atom, and the instruction set makes that entity/event head split load-bearing.

review.notes: Statement 24 attaches the same PP to the hunt event, which is a defensible post-verbal VP reading there even if the passage treats "the nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row" as a fixed definite description. The fictional day-of-year dating ("day 258 of Year 1") maps cleanly onto the stated (Day n)/(Year n) terms, and the compound genus, group/cardinality, distribution-rule and Before/after-the-hunt handling all follow doctrine.

issues.reason: In "The nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row shrank" the PP is preverbal and therefore inside the subject NP, so it states where the crowd is — which *Where a THING is* routes to the entity-attached containment head ("in / at / inside / within" → LocatedIn) under the section's explicit bar on swapping the two heads ("never Location on an entity — the head *is* the event-vs-entity distinction"); (Location sk_shrink_1 harbor_row) instead asserts a location of the shrinking the text never states while dropping the stated location of the crowd.

new_gaps: Fictional day-of-year dating ("day 258 of Year 1"): the Time term lexicon offers only (Day <n>) as a day-of-month slot, so a 258th-day-of-year value has no licensed term and the parse can only overload the day-of-month constructor; a licensed form would need a day-of-year (or era-day) term that date comparison and the "next day" increment could still order.
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form for the subject-internal locative in sentence 4 is the entity-attached (LocatedIn sk_crowd_1 harbor_row) — "at" is one of the four containment prepositions — with no (Location sk_shrink_1 harbor_row) on the shrink event; a licensed form exists, so this is a mis-slot rather than a gap.
adjudication.notes: The sentence-3 PP ("hunted the nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row") is postverbal and so genuinely attachable to the hunt event, as the reviewer allowed; only the preverbal sentence-4 PP is forced NP-internal. The compound genera, group/cardinality and distribution rules, the lantern-of-station PartOf and the before/after-the-hunt orderings all follow doctrine.
